game.title: Thinn Hama
game.description: A strategic multi-generational board game similar to checkers, played with 18 pieces per player on a marked board. Players aim to create three-in-a-row to capture opponent pieces.
equipment: Wooden or cardboard board with grid
36 pieces (18 each, often shells or stones)
howToPlay: Step 1: Board features intersecting lines forming a grid.
Step 2: Players place pieces one at a time on intersections.
Step 3: Objective is to get three pieces in a straight line.
Step 4: When a player forms three in a row, they remove one opponent piece.
Step 5: Players cannot place three in a row initially.
Step 6: After all pieces are placed, players move one piece per turn.
Step 7: Movement is limited to adjacent intersections along lines.
Step 8: Game continues until one player has only two pieces left.
Step 9: Remaining player with more pieces wins.
Step 10: Requires strategic positioning and forward planning.
